sermon.title: Do the Rights of the Adult Supersede the Rights of the Child?
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer reads the Constitution’s promise to “our posterity” and asks whether adult freedoms supersede children’s rights. Citing abortion, fatherlessness, abuse, homelessness and what schools teach, he defines a parent biblically from Deuteronomy 5:16 and Ephesians 6, applies Isaiah 5’s woes, and calls the church to stand for innocent children and Bible parents.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Statistics are given as spoken and have not been checked (1.3 million abortions/1% rape-incest-life; ~48% unwed births, 44%, 36%, 22 million; 50% divorce; 6.3% abused, 1,640 murdered, 621,000 sexually abused; 1.6 million homeless children average age 9, 50%, 34%, 42%, 75%, 85%; $19 trillion debt). Caption fixes: “domestic tranquility,” “Deuteronomy 5:16,” “Romans 13:7,” “Valium.” Sensitive content kept as spoken: transgender surgery description, homosexuality in schools, Islam/Quran, Obama/White House rainbow lighting.

faqs.question: What does “general welfare” mean in the Constitution?
faqs.answer: He cites Noah Webster’s 1828 dictionary: welfare is exemption from misfortune, sickness and calamity—the conditions for healthy, comfortable living.

faqs.question: Does the Bible encourage slavery?
faqs.answer: He says no; Old Testament slaves were indentured for debt for six years and then given a fresh start, not kidnapped.

faqs.question: Why does he say slaves were counted as three-fifths?
faqs.answer: He says the southern states won the debate so they could gain more representatives and keep slavery active.

faqs.question: How many abortions does he say come from rape, incest or the mother’s life at risk?
faqs.answer: He says only 1% of the 1.3 million yearly abortions.

faqs.question: How many children does he say were murdered compared to soldiers?
faqs.answer: Multiplying 1,640 a year over 12 years gives about 20,000 children murdered—three times the roughly 7,000 soldiers killed in Iraq and Afghanistan.

faqs.question: What is the average age of homeless children he cites?
faqs.answer: Nine years old; he says he checked other sources and they all said the same.

faqs.question: Does he say evolution has evidence?
faqs.answer: He says they cannot give tangible evidence, cannot find a missing link, and the big bang is fantasy propaganda to escape Bible morality.

faqs.question: Is there a superior race?
faqs.answer: He says evolution discriminates against women and colored people, but the Bible says we all come from one blood; there is no superior race.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And He has made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the face of the earth, and has determined their preappointed times and the boundaries of their dwellings,

faqs.question: Must a wife submit to a husband who asks her to violate the Bible?
faqs.answer: He says no way—women taught to submit no matter what were put under bondage.

faqs.question: Is there a time for Christians to get angry?
faqs.answer: He says yes; the church needs to get angry, reject evil and speak out against it.
